plain_english_policy: This bill restricts when police officers can issue a ticket for not wearing a seatbelt in Alabama.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Under current rules, failing to wear a seatbelt is a 'primary offense,' meaning an officer can pull someone over solely for that violation. This bill changes the law so that a citation or arrest warrant for a seatbelt violation can only be issued if the driver or passenger was already stopped and arrested (or cited) for a completely different crime.
sponsorship_supports_position: Representative Morrow sponsored this bill to limit the circumstances under which seatbelt citations are issued.
evidence_quotes: "This bill would only allow citations for safety belt violations if the person is stopped for a separate violation of the law and is issued a ticket for the separate violation."

"Notwithstanding any provision of law to the contrary, only a warning citation may be issued for a violation of this chapter unless a person is stopped by a law enforcement officer for a separate violation of law..."
